entries.text: Full-specification TPC-H and TPC-DS results now rank on QphH@Size and QphDS@SF, with Power@Size and Throughput@Size as secondary metrics. A result ranks only when its throughput and refresh or maintenance steps all succeeded, and power-only results keep their Power@Size ranking.
details: Result bundles record what load time includes in summary.tpc_metrics.load_scope.

The results Explorer snapshot builder now emits read model 19 by default, with the composite metrics, the load scope and any per-step non-transactional disclosure; read models 17 and 18 stay selectable and leave combined bundles out.
